title: Sirrin Al'arshi Mai Nisa
intro: Wani sarki mai ƙarfi, wanda Allah ya albarkace shi da mulki mai ban mamaki, ya fuskanci ƙalubale na musamman wanda ya shafi sarauniya daga wata ƙasa mai nisa. Sarkin ya nemi ya nuna ikon Allah da hikimarsa, inda ya haifar da wani abin mamaki wanda ya saɓa wa dokokin lokaci da sarari. Za ku iya fahimtar cikakkun bayanai game da wannan abin al'ajabi?
clues: An bai wa mai mulki iko mai girma, wanda ya haɗa da iko akan halittun da ba a gani da kuma ikon sarrafa iska.
Wannan mai mulki ya sami labarin wata sarauniya mai arziki wadda take bauta wa rana, kuma ya yanke shawarar gayyatarta zuwa kotu.
Kafin zuwan sarauniya, mai mulkin ya nuna sha'awar kawo mata babban kujerar mulki daga masarautarta mai nisa.
Wani babban aljani ya miƙa tayin ɗaukar abin kafin mai mulki ya tashi daga majalisarsa.
Duk da haka, wanda ke da zurfin ilimin Littafi Mai Tsarki ya ba da damar samun sauƙi cikin sauri, yana kammala aikin cikin ƙiftawar ido.
Da isowarsa, mai mulkin ya ba da umarnin a canza abin don a gwada hankalin sarauniya da fahimtarta lokacin da ta isa fadar.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
